notes.subject: sehononono
notes.rationale: חסידה go tšwa go חסד (hesede) — nonyana ya botho go bana ba yona; sehononono ke phetolelo ya tlwaelegilego.

notes.subject: האנפה
notes.rationale: Mohuta o sa tsewego ka nnete — ba bangwe ba re nonyana e hlophinago, ba bangwe seanefa.

notes.subject: הדוכיפת
notes.rationale: Sekgokgontšhi (hoopoe) go dinomoro tše ntši; ba bangwe ba re nonyana ya naga.

translation: le sehononono, le seanefa go ya ka mohuta wa yona, le sekgokgontšhi le_manotswidi

tokens.gloss: go ya ka mohuta wa yona
